parsed.rationale: All eight members are unnamed extensions (name is empty string) on CGImage scattered across test files (ArtworkServiceTests.swift, ArtworkFetcherTests.swift, NowPlayingServiceTests.swift), a production source file (MultisourceArtworkService.swift), and an app-layer file (NowPlayingInfoCenterManager.swift) in three distinct packages (Artwork, AppServices, app:iOS). Because the cluster carries no field or method lists (fields_or_signature is empty for every record) and no structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, differing_slots, and shared_ancestor are all null), there is no grounded basis to assert these extensions share meaningful content rather than merely extending the same Apple framework type for locally divergent purposes. Consolidating unnamed CGImage extensions across package boundaries and between test and production contexts would couple unrelated concerns without demonstrated benefit.
